title: Queue Message
description: Structural schema companion for contract: durable-queue/v0. The message envelope as stored and delivered. The broker never interprets payload or attributes. Exactly one of payload or payload_ref is present. Message lines do not repeat the capability token; the capability profile is the discovery root.

id.description: Broker-assigned message id, unique per queue for the life of the ledger. Opaque to producers and consumers.

idempotency_key.description: Producer-chosen key. A repeated key within the backend's idempotency window returns the original receipt. Scope is the queue, not the ledger. Distinct from service-job JobSpec idempotency.

payload_contract.description: Host-less capability token naming the payload's contract (for example contract: service-job/v0). The queue carries it; it does not validate against it.

payload.description: Opaque JSON payload. Validated by the consumer against payload_contract, never by the broker.

not_before.description: Earliest delivery time (RFC 3339, UTC). Requires capability delay.

expires_at.description: After this time the message is never delivered; the broker purges it with reason expired.

max_attempts.description: Attempt count at which a nack dead-letters instead of returning the message to ready.

parent_id.description: Set on children produced by fan_out.

ordering_key.description: Requires capability ordering_key. Without it, no ordering is promised.

priority.description: Requires capability priority. Higher is delivered first among ready messages.

attributes.description: Producer-owned string attributes. The broker never interprets them.

artifactRef.description: Reference to a large body held as a contract: data-artifact/v0 artifact. Requires capability payload_ref.

descriptor.description: Path or reference to the artifact descriptor.
